news_summary: Aryash Shyam, 14, a ninth-grader in Pennsylvania's Lehigh Valley, has won a national writing prize for historical fiction and had all three of his John Locke essays shortlisted from 100,227 entries worldwide.
payoff: Writing beyond his years — and his grade.
